title_original: ‘Hexed’ Red Carpet Premiere Photos: Hailee Steinfeld, Jodie Foster, Rashida Jones & More
excerpt_original: The voice cast of Hexed reunited to celebrate the animated film’s premiere. Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones, Stephen Fry, and Jodie Foster were among the stars who walked the red carpet at the El Capitan Theatre on Thursday night. Other actors at the event included Cheri Oteri,…

blocks.text: The voice cast of Hexed reunited to celebrate the animated film’s premiere.
Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones, Stephen Fry, and Jodie Foster were among the stars who walked the red carpet at the El Capitan Theatre on Thursday night.
Other actors at the event included Cheri Oteri, Ron Funches, Ginnifer Goodwin, Devon Sawa, Sasheer Zamata, Yvette Nicole Brown, Scarlett Spears, Jodie Benson, among many others.

blocks.text: Hexed follows an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (Steinfeld) who discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her out of suburbia and into a spectacle-filled journey through a vast witch realm called Hexe. F
Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

Goggins voices Beef Roger Crummchuk, a reclusive, magical three-eyed cat who forges an uneasy alliance with Billie and Alice. Foster voices Queen Celeste, a sinister figure who will stop at nothing to maintain her power in perpetuity over Hexe.

blocks.text: The voice cast of Hexed , which opens in theaters on November 25, also includes Walton Goggins, Tracey Ullman, Henry Winkler, Dan Stevens, Brett Gelman, Samson Kayo, Jimmy O. Yang, Drew (McIntyre) Galloway, Kathy Najimy, Wayne Knight, Alan Tudyk, Randall Park, Bill Farmer, Pat McAfee, Chris Parnell, Sarah-Nicole Robles, Rachel Dratch, Ariana Madix, Kellie Gerardi, Abraham Benrubi and Josh Dallas.

The film is directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand; co-directed by Josie Trinidad; produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino; written by Walt Disney Animation Studios Chief Creative Officer Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller; and features an original score by Kris Bowers.
